transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Rowan, Maintenance Control Officer. I need to begin the quarter-end property reconciliation for the items currently tagged as unserviceable — battery packs, rugged tablets, power converters, and electronic test cables. Per policy, I need to confirm current technical status and disposition recommendations with the responsible sections before I sign the disposition order. Could the property office, repair bench, and calibration desk each provide their current status and recommended disposition for these items? I'll need to schedule the actions within normal weekday operating hours.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, regarding the six unserviceable battery packs: the battery shop confirmed this morning that all six have swollen casings covered by a manufacturer safety bulletin. They must be quarantined rather than repaired. We've scheduled property-office pickup for Wednesday at 1000. I should note that the inspection sheet is still in our shop binder and has not yet been entered in the maintenance control log — we'll get that documented.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, regarding the eight rugged tablets currently tagged as unserviceable: IT support has completed certified data erasure on all eight and found them serviceable for the training cell. They must be reissued to the training cell with an asset transfer scheduled for Friday at 0900. The data erasure certificates are filed in the IT ticket system but are not yet attached to the reconciliation packet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Ma'am, regarding the four unserviceable power converters: the power systems bench verified this morning that all four have replaceable fan modules and should be sent for repair, with repair-bench priority 2. I should note that the bench verification was completed this morning, but the work-order recommendation has not yet been posted to the maintenance control log.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Ma'am, regarding the ten electronic test cables currently tagged as unserviceable: the calibration desk confirmed that all ten failed their scheduled calibration check but remain suitable for controlled calibration return. They must be sent to the calibration desk with a calibration request dated Tuesday. I should note that the signed calibration worksheet is completed and awaiting property-section filing.
